Days unvisited before abandoned RV cleanup list (real-life days)

Number of real-world calendar days since last entry before an RV interior appears in Manage abandoned interiors. Default: 21. This uses the server or host wall clock; game-time speed, sleeping and restored world clocks do not affect it.
While enabled and before the first native outage, RV interiors can use world-grid power. Disable to require installed batteries immediately. Applies on the server without a restart.
Allow players to enter RV interiors

Allows regular players to enter RV interiors. Disable to block new regular-player entry immediately. Players already inside can always exit. Moderators and administrators retain entry and all Vehicle Manager controls. Takes effect immediately. Default: enabled.
Allow world-grid power after first outage
After native world power has failed once, allow a later restored grid to power RV interiors again. Off keeps the permanent battery handoff. Applies immediately and does not erase outage history.

Allows a one-time randomized zombie encounter in a newly assigned, previously undiscovered RV interior. Existing, claimed, or modified interiors are never selected. Available in single player, hosted, and dedicated multiplayer. Default: off.
Random range is zero through this value. Default: 3.
Random range is zero through this value. Default: 3.
Random range is zero through this value. Default: 2.
Very large bus, boat, or heavy-trailer maximum zombies
Random range is zero through this value. Default: 5.
Chance that an eligible newly discovered RV contains any controlled zombie encounter. The final randomized count may still be zero. Default: 25.
New Marine Bay battery chance per slot

Every RV interior receives a Marine Power Bay on a free floor square. For each of its four slots, the server rolls this chance once when creating the bay. 0 means empty; 100 means four batteries. Existing bays are never rerolled. Changes affect the next new bay immediately.
Zombies currently chasing the player will prevent them from entering vehicle interiors, no matter the distance.
RV Power Bank: power usage multiplier
Scales battery drain from powered RV interiors, including unloaded-interior catch-up. 0 disables drain, 0.5 halves it, 1 is normal, and 2 doubles it. Default: 0.5 (half rate).
Electrical level required to build an RV Power Bank. Default: 5. Set to 0 to remove this skill requirement.
Electrical wire consumed by construction. Default: 25.
RV Power Bank: green light bulbs
Green light bulbs consumed by construction. Default: 1.
Metal bars consumed by construction. Default: 4.
Metal plates consumed by construction. Default: 25.
Metalworking level required to build an RV Power Bank. Default: 4. Set to 0 to remove this skill requirement.
RV Power Bank: red light bulbs
Red light bulbs consumed by construction. Default: 1.
Propane-torch charge units consumed by construction. A full torch contains 10. The physical torch is still required at 0.
Return players to vehicle seats on exit

When enabled, exiting an RV interior attempts to return each player to their previous seat, or another free seat in the same vehicle. Disabling this function returns players to the rear corner of the vehicle and may reduce desync pressure on the server during peak hours. Default: enabled.
Zombies this distance or closer to a player will prevent them from entering vehicle interiors (0 = disabled).
Required Electrical skill to craft a shore cable. Applies to the craft recipe immediately.
Maximum pedestal-to-RV distance in exterior tiles. Connected RVs beyond the new range disconnect at the next check.
Electrical-wire units used when crafting one shore cable. Applies to the craft recipe immediately.
Shore charging percent per game hour
Charging rate per installed vehicle battery while a connected pedestal has native or generator-supplied electricity. 0 disables charging. Applies on the next charge check.

Shows the lower-screen Vehicle Manager shortcut prompt near an eligible vehicle. This changes only the hint; the configured hotkey and context-menu access remain available. Takes effect immediately. Default: enabled.
Retained for existing saves only. Every RV interior now receives a Marine Power Bay on a free floor square regardless of this former toggle.

Choose a Vehicle Manager shortcut, or select Disabled to turn the shortcut and its prompt off. When disabled, right-click an eligible vehicle and choose Vehicle Manager. Apply saves the choice immediately.
